In Aladdin, what is the name of the scheming scarlet parrot who serves as Jafar's spy and sidekick?

decision: Inverse Iago/parrot relationship. Retain the more specific character-name question. Original q80 also has a nested animal option: a macaw is a kind of parrot; it must not be approved as single-answer.
